name: domain_candidates simple name dedupes
spec_quote: domain_candidates(company) → list of domains, no duplicates, in this order: words = company key (lower-case, text in parentheses removed, legal suffixes removed, punctuation → space) minus "the" and "and"; ... Candidates: all words joined + ".com"; first two words joined + ".com"; first word + ".com" (left out when the first word has < 3 letters and there are more words); words joined by "-" + ".com"; when ≥ 3 words, their initials + ".com"; finally all words joined + ".org".
